parameters.name: CategoryName
parameters.description:
The category of the configuration item. Supported categories:

*   CommonResourceConfig
*   DLCAutoRecycle
*   DLCPriorityConfig
*   DSWPriorityConfig
*   QuotaMaximumDuration
*   CommonTagConfig

parameters.name: ConfigKeys
parameters.description:
The key of the configuration item. Supported keys:

*   tempStoragePath: Temporary storage path. This key can be used only when CategoryName is set to CommonResourceConfig.
*   isAutoRecycle: Automatic recycle configuration. This key can be used only when CategoryName is set to DLCAutoRecycle.
*   priorityConfig: Priority configuration. This key can be used only when CategoryName is set to DLCPriorityConfig or DSWPriorityConfig.
*   quotaMaximumDuration: Maximum run time of DLC jobs for a quota. This key can be used only when CategoryName is set to QuotaMaximumDuration.
*   predefinedTags: The predefined tags of the workspace. All created resources must have tags

parameters.name: Labels
parameters.description: The tags used as filter conditions. Separate multiple tags with commas (,). These conditions are in an AND relationship.

parameters.name: Verbose
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to show the tag information.

*   true
*   false

example.unifiedCli: aliyun aiworkspace list-configs --workspace-id 87000 --category-name CommonResourceConfig --config-keys tempStoragePath --labels key1=value1,key2=value2 --verbose true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun aiworkspace GET /api/v1/workspaces/87000/configs --region cn-hangzhou --Verbose true --CategoryName CommonResourceConfig --Labels 'key1=value1,key2=value2' --ConfigKeys tempStoragePath --header "Content-Type=application/json"
